SOURCE OPINION The article says the market is de-risking the AI/AI-capex trade and watching hyperscaler monetization and FCF breakeven closely as the key swing factor for credit and risk. C-1ce641e140825c C-010122a2d434dc C-533c8356f9d295
MODEL INFERENCE If any of these constraints bind, hyperscaler and AI-infrastructure capex and the related suppliers' volumes could fall short of the ~$1.1tn market expectation; the article does not quantify the earnings hit.
